## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat: …`, `fix: …`); it becomes the squash commit message.
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO).
- [ ] `go test ./...` and `golangci-lint run` pass.
- [ ] Generated files are up to date (`go generate ./...`).
- [ ] Generator changes come with a golden test.
- [ ] Test documents contain no personal or confidential data.
